question_text:
Fill in the blanks to complete the if-statement with a compound condition that checks if 'height' is at least 150 and 'weight' is at least 50:
[BLANK1] height [BLANK2] 150 [BLANK3] weight [BLANK4] 50:
    print('Eligible')

blanks.description: Operator to check if height is greater than or equal to 150
Operator to check if weight is greater than or equal to 50
